heroHeadline: China Retaliates Against US With Drone Export Curbs and Sanctions on Seven Entities
heroSubtitle: China hit back at Washington's new forced-labor tariffs with drone export curbs, sanctions on seven US entities, and a probe into imported printers — as Q2 GDP growth slowed to 4.3%, its weakest pace since late 2022, Xi launched a 29-nation AI alliance in Shanghai, and Beijing's new Ethnic Unity Law took full effect. From the Xia Dynasty's legendary founding ~2070 BCE to the world's most consequential great-power chess match of 2026 — 4,000 years of Chinese civilization tracked in real time.
footerNote: Data sourced from official Chinese government reports (NBS, MFA, NPC, PLARF), major news outlets (Reuters, AP, BBC, Xinhua, SCMP, CNBC, CNN), academic scholarship, and international institutional analyses (UN, IMF, World Bank, SIPRI, ASPI, USCC, AEI, CFR).
